fields.summary: Plan run for change set 01M602TG (Review status in Rex), which serves milestone 4. There was no owner in the session (RHIZA_AUTONOMOUS=1), so nothing was asked and no owner words are quoted. Decided by the milestone-4 intent and the landed run-reports-progress Decision: a run reports its progress through OSC 7501 program status. Gaps found in the code: runRex.status reports only a checks step's live check sessions (checksStatus), so a review run's fixer and verifier sessions, its code check and its open questions are not reported. Leaves: live review fixer and verifier sessions as child records, the code check on the root record, and open review questions on the root record. Open for the arbiter: whether open review questions also get child records, or only the root's blocked notice.
fields.title: Review status in Rex, planned in an autonomous plan run
